newsitem.title: USA: Conn Pequot tribe seeks recognition, casino -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Conn Pequot tribe seeks recognition, casino -- paper.

text.p: Connecticut's Eastern Pequot Indian Tribe is about to be actively considered for federal recognition, which would almost definitely mean a third Indian casino in the state, the Hartford Courant said on Monday.

A final decision is probably one to two years away, the paper said, adding the Eastern Pequots have been prepaing for gambling since 1995, when the entered an agreement with a company to build and manage a casino on tribal land, just a few miles from the Mashantucket Pequot Foxwoods Resort Casino.

The state attorney general, Richard Blumenthal, also will review the Eastern Pequots' application, and he has fought initiatives from the best-known tribes, the Mashantucket Pequots, the Mohegans, and the Golden Hill Paugussetts, the paper said.
